text:
maria: Quick check — planning a midnight canary run for the new dedicated pool. Need to reserve 2x A100 (us-west1) for 00:30–02:00 PT. Vendor portal shows some backorder flags. @devon can you confirm if we can temporarily claim slots or if we should fallback to h100?

devon: I looked at the portal. There's a small backorder for A100s, but partner says some units released at 23:00 PT. I can try to snag a soft-hold. If not, fallback to H100 is OK (slightly different perf).

sam: tagging oncall — if we land A100s we should update GKE nodePool autoscaler settings too. Quick command to check current quota:```gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-prod --format="json" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'```

maria: thanks — also want to avoid any infra churn during the canary. If we do H100 fallback, can we keep job size identical? (just using different SKUs)

devon: H100 has higher memory; perf profile differs but for the smoke test we can keep same container image and reduce batch size by 1 if latency spikes. I'll open a tiny runbook entry.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-5821 — vendor backorder follow-up + soft-hold request (devon).

ashley: finance OK with a one-off reserved bump for the midnight window if devon confirms vendor price. Please ping me final cost estimate (small amount). :thumbsup:

devon: vendor confirmed soft-hold attempt at 22:50 PT. If we fail, plan B: spin two h100 ephemeral instances in us-west1 with preemptible blending and cap to 90% CPU. I'll post the terraform snippet below to request the soft-hold to procurement:```resource "vendor_slot" "midnight_canary" {
  region = "us-west1"
  sku    = "A100"
  count  = 2
  hold_window = "2025-03-21T00:30:00-07:00/2025-03-21T02:00:00-07:00"
}```

maria: perfect. @sam can you add the autoscaler tweak to the canary kustomize (reduce maxSurge for node pool)?

sam: on it, will open PR now and reference INC-5821. Should be a trivial kustomize patch.

maria: ✅ thanks all. I'll wait for devon update around 23:00 PT and backup plan if needed. :eyes:
